title: BeWise: Izisho Zansuku Zonke
shortDescription: Isisho sosuku namazwi okukhuthaza esithombeni esihle, ngolimi lwakho. Mahhala.
fullDescription:
I-BeWise ikunika isisho esisodwa esihle njalo ekuseni, esithombeni esigcwele isikrini futhi ngolimi lwakho. Imizuzwana eyishumi ukusifunda. Usuku lonke ukuhamba naso.

Qala usuku lwakho ngogqozi, hhayi ngezinkundla zokuxhumana. Akukho ukuskrola okungapheli, akukho ukubala izinsuku ezilandelanayo, akukho msindo: isisho sosuku kuphela, esikhethwe esihlokweni osidinga manje.

KUNGANI ABANTU BETHANDA I-BEWISE
• Isisho esisha esikhuthazayo njalo ekuseni, esivela ezishweni namazwi okuhlakanipha angaphezu kuka-1,100 akhethwe ngokucophelela, ababhali, abaholi, abasubathi nezazi
• Izihloko ezi-9: Ugqozi, Ubuholi, Impilo, Uthando, Amahlaya, Ubuciko, Ezemidlalo, Abafundi kanye Nokuhlela Amakhompyutha
• Ngolimi lwakho, ngokuzenzakalela: i-BeWise ilandela ulimi lwefoni yakho futhi ihumusha isisho ngasinye nesikrini ngasinye
• I-widget yesikrini sasekhaya enesisho sanamuhla nesithombe saso
• Isikhumbuzo esimnene sansuku zonke ngesikhathi osikhethayo
• Ingobo yomlando ephelele: buyela emuva ubone zonke izisho ezedlule
• Thanda izisho ezikukhulumayo bese wabelana nganoma yisiphi isisho njengesithombe esilungele ukuthunyelwa
• Isebenza kumafoni nakumathebulethi

YAKHELWE UKUTHULA
• Mahhala, ayidingi i-akhawunti, ayinazo izikhangiso futhi ayikulandeleli

Kwenze kube umkhuba: vula i-BeWise nekhofi lakho lasekuseni, engeza i-widget esikrinini sasekhaya, bese uvumela umcabango owodwa omuhle ubeke umoya wosuku lwakho.
